failure.summary: The sandbox denied loopback listen and Node child-process operations. Nine files failed, 42 passed; 111 tests failed and 207 passed. Representative errors were listen EPERM on 127.0.0.1 and spawnSync node EPERM.

corroboration.approvedHostReplay: The identical command ran outside the sandbox; all sandbox EPERM failures disappeared and only the separately preserved Node Control fixed-timeout baseline remained.
